list.name: Animusic
list.description: Please check #subgroup-announcements and #animusic in the Discord server for any updates! Any questions please DM bepis3206

list.name: Cosplay
list.description: A hands on subgroup focused on cosplay workshops and event preparation. Members collaborate on builds, share techniques, and help support major club events like Maid Café and Kamekon. Check the cosplay channel for updates.

list.name: Weekly Watchers
list.description: Weekly Watchers is a chill group to unwind after the school week and watch the new seasonal anime with friends!

list.name: Book Club
list.description: A subgroup for reading manga! The book club subgroup functions like a regular book club where a short manga is read every few weeks and discussion is hosted in the #book club channel in our discord. Suggestions for what to read are always welcome!

list.name: Rainbow
list.description: A welcoming space for LGBTQ+ anime fans and allies. Open to everyone and focused on community connection, representation, and discussion.

list.name: Dubbers
list.description: Dub your favorite anime scenes using your own unique voice! Whether you are new to voice acting or not, participate in fun VA activities with us and immerse yourself in the community. Pick up the dubbers role now if interested!
